paragraphs: Mar son of Rav Acha son of Rava.

[Moed Katan 11b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.11b.12) relates that he and Maryon, son of Ravin, jointly owned [a yoke of oxen](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Moed_Katan.11b.12.1). A bereavement befell Mar, son of Rav Acha, and he withdrew his ox from the pair. Rav Ashi said, “Would a great man such as Mar, son of Rav Acha, act this way?”[^2]

notes.text: Rashi explains that each partner owned one ox of the pair. Mar withheld his ox from plowing during mourning; Rav Ashi’s question objects to the resulting loss to his partner, rather than praising the withdrawal.

[Rashi’s explanation](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Moed_Katan.11b.12.5) makes the objection about avoiding a loss to the other partner. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2416&lang=en) pairs Mar with Marion son of Ravin as well.
